Place of care in advanced cancer: a qualitative systematic literature review of patient preferences. BACKGROUND It is commonly written that more patients wish to die at home than currently achieve this. However, the evidence for preferences for place of terminal care and death has not been systematically reviewed. AIM To carry out a systematic literature review of the preferences for place of care and death among advanced cancer patients. METHOD Studies were identified using systematic database searches of MEDLINE (1966-1999), PsychLit (1974-1999), and Bath Information Data Service (BIDS) (1981-1999).
